title: Abstraction in Java library APIs
answer: Java libraries use abstraction everywhere. Code often programs to interfaces such as List, Map, Set, Executor, or Path while concrete implementations do the work. Abstract classes such as InputStream also hide common mechanics behind a stable API. The benefit is that client code focuses on operations and contracts instead of implementation details.
